required_endpoint: Full-class joint certificate plus both complete-source physical crossing witnesses; show that observed response range alone cannot imply the conclusion

statistics: All original rows and denominators, independent Bernoulli shots under a fixed candidate. Candidatewise inversion, no full-class exclusion from optimizer failure
stability: Audit deposit inventory, paper control descriptions and every repeated literal word; do not infer chronology from file order or import calibration from another epoch
search: Refit general stationary CPTP model using all original data before interpreting a saved point's rejection; numerical optimization never supplies an exclusion certificate
limits: No new acquisition, external contact, novelty claim or unverified empirical context allowance
